description_en: Set to `1` to force-enable fine-grained tool input streaming. Without this, the API buffers tool input parameters fully before sending delta events, which can delay display on large tool inputs. Anthropic API only: has no effect on Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry
description_ja: ツールへの入力パラメータをストリーミング形式で受け取るよう強制的に有効化するには `1` に設定します。
